fields.subject: ShardBatch<TResult>
fields.condition: a ShardBatch<TResult> has one or more registered batch steps
fields.trigger: the batch executes for a shard
fields.response: execute every registered step in registration order, retain each non-default TResult returned by a step, and return the most recently retained TResult
fields.postcondition: the execution result is default(TResult) when no registered step returns a non-default TResult
